entry_lifecycle.catalyst_logic: Firm US activity, resilient euro-area growth, and crude slipping toward 85 as exports recovered undercut the growth-currency washout over the next month.
entry_lifecycle.realization_logic: AUDUSD reclaims the 20-day breakdown as soft-landing growth reasserts in the pro-cyclical currency that was sold with the broader dollar surge.

entry_rationale: The June 2027 SOFR pay stacks onto the existing fifty million March pay after a large five-day backup, with only a few basis points left from June to September. Long AUDUSD is the cleaner pro-cyclical add.
entry_thesis: Hold the SOFR and AONIA March 2027 pays and buy fifteen million dollars of AUDUSD. Firm US activity, warm inflation, and resilient euro-area growth still leave room in the soft-landing path, while the pays already carry the higher-rate leg. AUDUSD is the new pro-cyclical leg after a 20-day downside break that ran with the other growth currencies even as crude eased on recovering exports. The view fails if that dollar break extends and front-end rates reprice from a grind into a financial-conditions shock.

events.rationale: The June 2027 SOFR pay stacks onto the existing fifty million March pay after a large five-day backup, with only a few basis points left from June to September. Long AUDUSD is the cleaner pro-cyclical add.
Close the 15 million Australian-dollar long. Spot 0.6731 versus 0.6757 is a 20-day downside break, and replacing it with another cyclical long would repurchase the same breakdown.

exit_rationale: Close the 15 million Australian-dollar long. Spot 0.6731 versus 0.6757 is a 20-day downside break, and replacing it with another cyclical long would repurchase the same breakdown.
invalidation: AUDUSD extends its 20-day downside break while SOFR March 2027 settles up through the June-September strip, so the yield backup becomes a parallel tightening shock.
